title: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.32203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during

translated_title: OmniEVIE：证据向量感知的多模态检索嵌入模型
translated_abstract: 多模态检索需要匹配密集页面、细粒度实体、有序视频以及智能体的工具和记忆。单向量嵌入会丢失局部证据信息，交叉编码器需要对每个召回项进行在线重读，而未压缩的晚期交互存储开销过大难以部署。我们提出了 OmniEVIE，一个 4.5B 参数的多向量嵌入模型，统一覆盖文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具，采用单一压缩索引和三阶段检索器。每条记录最多存储 128 个维度为 64 的 int8 向量（9,472 字节，即每百万条记录仅 8.82 GiB），提供均值向量、1 比特符号位和 int8 多向量，分别服务于粗排、中排和精排，同时将每个命中结果精确定位到页面区域或视频区间。训练、合并、索引和检索进行协同设计：所有任务共享统一的检索格式，三级证据校验消除假负例，动态采样依据基线-教师差距，候选压缩采用 ST-HAC……
tldr: 提出 OmniEVIE——一个 45 亿参数的多向量嵌入模型，通过单一压缩索引和三阶段检索统一支持文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具的多模态检索，在极低存储成本下实现证据保留与细粒度命中定位。
en_tdlr: OmniEVIE is a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model that unifies retrieval across text, images, visual documents, video, and tools using one compressed index and a three-stage retriever, preserving local evidence with fine-grained localization at minimal storage cost.
